title: BillyPay
tagline: Pay your Electricity, Internet and Gas bills from BillyPay the World Miniapp
description: I created this app using the World MiniApp SDK to enable real-world payments for real people. It integrates an API and supports stablecoins like USDC and other tokens like WLD. This is especially helpful for verified users who receive WLD tokens monthly, showing how crypto can improve people’s lives
how_its_made: I'm using the world mini-app sdk to make a fast integration with a platform that has a real users, I create and Smart Contract in solidity and deploy to World chain to receive the payments from the users and emit an event to execute the payment with the service providers like Electricity, Internet, Gas and Credit Card soon
